parts:

messages.subject: Re: COV for Model Statements Not Working
parts:
Hi Nathan,

Nice to hear from you. Are you certain this is case? Something like that doesn't usually fly under the radar with all the checks in the package.....Also, I can't seem to reproduce the issue. See below:

##---------------------------
library(mirt)

set.seed(1)
n <- 8
a <- matrix(c(rlnorm(n/2,.2,.3), numeric(n), rlnorm(n/2,.2,.3)), nrow=8)

# for the graded model, ensure that there is enough space between the intercepts,
# otherwise closer categories will not be selected often (minimum distance of 0.3 here)
diffs <- t(apply(matrix(runif(n*4, .3, 1), n), 1, cumsum))
diffs <- -(diffs - rowMeans(diffs))
d <- diffs + rnorm(n)

items <- simdata(a, d, 500, itemtype = 'graded', sigma = matrix(c(1, .5, .5, 1), 2, 2))
